parameters.content:
## Flow 1: Subscription expiry
Runs every day at 7am. Reminds subscribers 3 days, 2 days and 0 days before expiry. After expiry it marks the row Expired, removes the user from the private group and tells them.

## Flow 2a: Customer commands and plan selection
Handles /start, /plans, /pay, /support, /status and the inline buttons. Choosing a plan adds or updates the subscriber row as Pending and sends the bank details.

## Flow 2b: Payment proof and admin approval
A photo from the customer is sent to the admin with Approve and Disapprove buttons. Approved: row marked Paid with an expiry date, user unbanned and sent a one-time invite link. Not approved: row marked Not Valid.
